qwen_reference_text: Because a deed is not a toy. A deed is the only word in any language that means this is mine and the world has to agree. The breathing got closer. Out of the black came a shape too big to be a man and too graceful to be a beast. A broken crown curved between its horns.

jobs.spoken_text: I hit stone. My shoulder screamed. Somewhere in the dark, something enormous breathed. And the system finished reading me.
